label: Specification for: AMENDMENT_COUNTRYCODE_STANDARDIZED
description: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:sourceAuthority is not available; INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the value of dwc:countryCode is bdqval:Empty; AMENDED the value of dwc:countryCode if it can be unambiguously interpreted to a value in the bdqval:sourceAuthority; otherwise NOT_AMENDED bdqval:sourceAuthority default = "ISO 3166-1-alpha-2" {[https://www.iso.org/iso-3166-country-codes.html]} {ISO 3166-1-alpha-2 Country Code search [https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#search]}
expectedResponse: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:sourceAuthority is not available; INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the value of dwc:countryCode is bdqval:Empty; AMENDED the value of dwc:countryCode if it can be unambiguously interpreted to a value in the bdqval:sourceAuthority; otherwise NOT_AMENDED
example1: dwc:countryCode="Aust.": Response.status=NOT_AMENDED, Response.result=, Response.comment="dwc:countryCode contains an ambiguous value"
example2: dwc:countryCode="Australia": Response.status=AMENDED, Response.result=dwc:countryCode="AU", Response.comment="dwc:countryCode contains an interpretable value"
